Once upon a starry night, deep in the woods where Pack 149 gathers around the campfire, it was time for a Bobcat ceremony...
Meet Max! Tonight, Max and his mom and dad are heading to the Pack 149 campfire for a very special night.
Is it tonight? Is it REALLY tonight?!
We’re so proud of you, buddy.
Here comes Akela. That’s what Cub Scouts call their leader.
Welcome, Max! Tonight you earn your Bobcat, the very first step on the Cub Scout trail!
Rustle, rustle... what’s that in the bushes?
Psst! I’m the Bobcat! Every Cub Scout adventure starts with me.
To earn your Bobcat, you need to know three big things...
Max, please give the Cub Scout sign and say the Scout Oath.
On my honor I will do my best
to do my duty to God and my country
and to obey the Scout Law;
to help other people at all times;
Perfect! You said that with your whole heart.
Now for the Scout Law. Tell us, Max: what is a Scout?
And last but not least... what is our motto?
Do Your Best! Three little words that turn every day, even the tricky ones, into a chance to grow.
Tonight, one of our Scouts has worked very hard. Will Max and his parents please come forward to take on the colors and spirit of Cub Scouting?
As Akela says each color, Mom and Dad take turns with the brush.
The paw print of the Bobcat on your forehead is the spirit of the Bobcat. It reminds you to do your best on the Cub Scout trail.
The marks under your eyes help you see the light of the Cub Scout trail. They stand for the bright spirit of Cub Scouting.
The mark on your nose helps you know right from wrong as you go along the Cub Scout trail.
The mark on your chin reminds you to always speak the truth.
Green stands for the spirit of nature.
The marks on each cheek guide you to live in harmony with the great outdoors.
Mom and Dad, please hand the brush to Max. It’s your turn now!
Max dips the brush in white paint and gives each parent a stripe down the nose.
White is also for love and guidance. Your parents are always with you, in your heart and in your spirit, helping you reach all your Scout goals.
Congratulations, Max. You are officially a Bobcat of Pack 149!
Every new Scout’s first milestone. A proud moment for Scouts and families alike. And for Max and his family, a brand-new adventure has begun!
A Scout is trustworthy, loyal, helpful, friendly, courteous, kind, obedient, cheerful, thrifty, brave, clean, and reverent.
